obs_datum.source: [B-D2] CO-OPS datum for LMSL (CO-OPS API datum names)

texts: [B-D1] The file label {'standard_name': 'sea_surface_height_above_geoid', 'long_name': 'water surface elevation above geoid'} names no datum ('geoid' is a generic surface); the datum LMSL is taken from NOAA documentation for version 3.1.0.

[B-D4] Model LMSL and CO-OPS MSL are both mean-sea-level datums and are treated as compatible, but their equivalence is not established: CO-OPS MSL is the tidal datum of the 1983-2001 National Tidal Datum Epoch [COOPSDAT], and NOAA does not state the epoch or realization of the model's LMSL [SCN26-51, NOMADS2D]. A mean offset (bias) can therefore include a reference difference; no vertical transformation was applied.
[B-Q2] 475 of 475 matched observations are CO-OPS preliminary (q=p) and may be revised.
[B-T2] 5 model records in the window had no observation at the same time.
